    It does make sense

    MakeSense is the first AI ML platform that automatically and accurately monitors the carb content of every meal, using a CGM sensor, bringing a new level of precision to food tracking and metabolic surveillance.

    The root cause of diet failure

    Inaccurate logs

    Existing tools rely on people to accurately, consistently and faithfully log their meals

    Lack of knowledge

    People lack the knowledge and discipline - so logs are inaccurate, and adherence deteriorates over time

    Lack of continuous data

    Healthcare professionals lack reliable, continuous, and objective nutrition data for personalised treatment

    Designed to drive change

    MakeSense automatically delivers precise data on mealtimes and amounts of carbs consumed. Set daily and weekly goals, get real-time feedback and just-in-time recommendations.

    View Demo

    Harness the power of real-time feedback

    Empowering care givers
    with precise data

    MakeSense transforms nutritional monitoring, providing care teams with rich insights for precise dietary assessments and recommendations
     

    Empowering users to enjoy every meal

    MakeSense eliminates the need to log contents of every meal and provides continuous feedback  - proven most effective for weight-loss and treatment of  pre-diabetes and diabetes. 

    Available as a  standalone platform or via API for integration with 3rd party applications

    Clinically proven accuracy
